notes.scoringBasis: Official Tama Starclassic Maple snare page supports the current Starclassic Maple snare line and zinc die-cast hoops. Secondary retailer listing for MAS1455BN-SSR supports Tama MLS50A/MLS50B strainer/butt and MS20RL14C 20-strand Super Sensitive Hi-Carbon Snare Wires for the modern Starclassic Maple 14x5.5 model. Applied to both modern Starclassic Maple 14x5.5 and 14x6.5 only because they are same-line/current-era paired models in this reference set; exact 14x6.5 retailer confirmation should still be treated as pending unless separately sourced. Stock batter/reso heads and snare bed type remain unconfirmed from official source.
